common.notAdvice: بيانات السوق للاطلاع فقط وليست نصيحة مالية. سوق العملات الرقمية شديد التقلب وقد تخسر كل رأس مالك.
common.offlineData: تعذّر الوصول للبيانات الحية — يتم عرض نسخة مخزنة. هذه الأسعار ليست حقيقية.

trade.title: تداول
trade.subtitle: تدرّب على التداول الفوري بأسعار السوق الحية.
trade.paperNotice: تداول تجريبي: تُنفَّذ الأوامر فوراً بالسعر الحي باستخدام رصيد NX افتراضي. لا أموال حقيقية ولا حفظ للأصول.

invest.title: استثمار
invest.subtitle: اقفل رصيد NX في خطط عائد ثابتة.
invest.simNotice: عائد محاكى. يُدفع من رصيد افتراضي وفق صيغة ثابتة — هذا ليس صندوقاً ولا تُجمع أموال حقيقية. المنتج الاستثماري الحقيقي يتطلب ترخيصاً رسمياً.
invest.earlyExitWarning: الخروج قبل الاستحقاق يلغي كل العائد ويخصم غرامة ٢٪ من رأس المال.

game.title: الألعاب
game.subtitle: ألعاب قابلة لإثبات النزاهة برصيد افتراضي.
game.riskNotice: هذه ألعاب بنمط المراهنة برصيد NX افتراضي فقط. لا تربطها بأموال حقيقية أبداً: المراهنة بأموال حقيقية تتطلب ترخيص قمار والتحقق من العمر والهوية ومولد أرقام عشوائية مدقق. هذه الألعاب خاسرة على المدى الطويل — نسبة البيت ٣٪.
game.fairnessExplain: تُشتق كل جولة من بذرة الخادم (المعلن هاشها مسبقاً) وبذرتك ورقم الجولة. بعد تدوير البذرة يمكنك إعادة حسابها والتأكد من مطابقتها للالتزام الأصلي.
game.verifyHint: يجب أن يطابق هاش SHA-256 لهذه البذرة الالتزام السابق. غطّت {{rounds}} جولة.
game.fairnessLimitation: تنويه صادق: تُولَّد البذرة داخل متصفحك هنا، فهي تثبت فقط أن النتيجة لم تتغير أثناء الجولة — وليست بديلاً عن مولد عشوائي مدقق لدى مشغل مرخّص.

predict.title: توقع السعر
predict.subtitle: التسوية على أسعار السوق الحية
predict.riskNotice: مراهنة قصيرة المدى صعود/هبوط برصيد افتراضي. الخيارات الثنائية بأموال حقيقية أداة مشتقة خاضعة للتنظيم ومحظورة على الأفراد في بريطانيا والاتحاد الأوروبي — لا تربط أموالاً حقيقية.

earn.title: اربح
earn.subtitle: مكافآت يومية ومهام ودعوات.
earn.referralNote: أرصدة الإحالة افتراضية. برنامج الإحالة الذي يدفع قيمة حقيقية قد يُعد ترويجاً مالياً — راجع القوانين المحلية أولاً.
earn.shareText: انضم إليّ في إف بي تي سواب — تطبيق العملات الرقمية في تيليجرام
earn.virtualNotice: كل المكافآت أرصدة NX افتراضية داخل التطبيق. ليس لها قيمة نقدية ولا يمكن سحبها.

wallet.noProvider: لم يتم العثور على محفظة. متصفح تيليجرام الداخلي لا يوفر محفظة — أضف TON Connect أو WalletConnect v2 للإنتاج (راجع WalletContext.jsx).
wallet.custodyNotice: للقراءة فقط. لا يملك هذا التطبيق أي عنوان إيداع ولن يطلب منك إرسال أي عملات. أي بوت يطلب تحويل أموال إليه هو احتيال.
wallet.resetDesc: إعادة الرصيد الافتراضي والمراكز والخطط والسجل إلى الحالة الأولية.
wallet.connectSubtitle: You keep your keys. This app never sees them.
wallet.wcDesc: MetaMask, Trust, Rainbow… via QR or deep link
wallet.injectedDesc: Use the wallet injected into this browser
wallet.createLocalDesc: New 12-word wallet, encrypted on this device
wallet.unlockLocalDesc: Enter your password to sign transactions
wallet.localRisk: The in-app wallet stores an encrypted key inside a Telegram WebView — no secure enclave, no hardware isolation. It is fine for small amounts, but anything you would be upset to lose belongs in MetaMask/Trust via WalletConnect, or on a hardware wallet.
wallet.noWcProject: Set VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID in your .env to enable WalletConnect. Get a free project ID at cloud.reown.com.
wallet.backupWarning: Write these 12 words down on paper, in order, and store them offline. Anyone with this phrase owns your funds forever. Nobody — not us, not Telegram — can recover it if you lose it. Never type it into any website or send it to anyone.
wallet.passwordDesc: This password encrypts your key on this device. It is not recoverable — if you forget it you will need your seed phrase.
wallet.unlockDesc: Your key is decrypted in memory only and cleared when you lock.
wallet.ackText: I understand that I alone control this wallet, that my seed phrase is the only way to recover it, and that nobody can restore my funds if I lose it.
wallet.forgetWarning: This deletes the encrypted key from this device. Without your seed phrase the funds are gone forever.

swap.title: مبادلة
swap.subtitle: Real on-chain swaps via {{dex}}
swap.nonCustodialNotice: Non-custodial: you sign every transaction from your own wallet and it broadcasts directly to the blockchain. This app takes no fee, holds no funds and has no address in the flow.
swap.slippageHelp: Your swap reverts if the price moves against you by more than this. Too low and it fails on volatile pairs; too high and you accept a worse fill.
swap.slippageHigh: Above 3% you are very exposed to sandwich attacks. Only raise this for illiquid tokens.
swap.highImpact: High price impact — this pool is thin and you will lose a lot of value on this trade. Consider a smaller amount.
swap.reviewNotice: Your wallet will ask you to sign. Check the amounts there too — what your wallet shows is what actually executes.
swap.verifyContracts: Always verify token contract addresses independently. Fake tokens with real names are the most common way people get drained.

err.NO_ROUTE: No route exists between these tokens.
err.QUOTE_FAILED: Could not fetch a price. Check your connection.
err.INSUFFICIENT_GAS: Not enough native coin to pay gas.
err.SLIPPAGE: Price moved beyond your slippage tolerance.

trade.title: Live markets, one tap away
trade.body: Real-time prices, charts and trends for thousands of tokens. Track what matters, spot moves early, and decide with data instead of noise.

swap.title: Swap directly on-chain
swap.body: Trade any supported token straight from your own wallet through PancakeSwap. No account, no deposit, no waiting for withdrawals.

custody.title: Your keys, your coins
custody.body: FBT never holds your funds and has no deposit address. You sign every transaction yourself. That also means your seed phrase is the only way back in — write it down and keep it offline.

settings.title: الإعدادات
settings.subtitle: Appearance, security and account.
settings.usernameNote: Shown only inside this app. It is not published on-chain and is not tied to your wallet address.
settings.hideBalancesSub: Mask amounts when others can see your screen
settings.biometricSub: Use fingerprint or face to open the app
settings.twoFactorSub: Require a 6-digit code from your authenticator
settings.twoFactorHow: Add this secret to Google Authenticator, Authy or any TOTP app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
settings.badCode: That code isn't right. Check your phone's clock is accurate and try the current code.
settings.recoveryWarning: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe and offline. Each works once. If you lose your authenticator and these codes, you'll have to reinstall the app and restore from your seed phrase.
settings.txConfirmSub: Always show a review screen before signing
settings.securityScope: These settings protect this app on this device — useful if someone picks up your unlocked phone. They cannot protect funds on-chain: anyone with your seed phrase can spend from any wallet app. Your seed phrase and wallet password remain the real protection.

bioErr.UNSUPPORTED: This device or browser doesn't support biometric unlock.
bioErr.FAILED: Biometric setup failed or was cancelled.

settings.syncScope: Syncs only your theme, accent, username and display preferences. Your seed phrase, wallet password and 2FA secret are never uploaded — they stay encrypted on this device.

about.title: من نحن
about.tagline: Trade & technology for a new economy
about.body1: FBT iran is a commercial trading company based in Khomeyni Shahr, Isfahan. Our roots are in conventional commerce, and our direction is firmly toward the new digital economy — where value moves without intermediaries and markets stay open around the clock.
about.body2: We built this exchange because we believe access to global markets shouldn't depend on where you happen to live, which bank will take you, or who is willing to hold your money. A decentralized exchange removes those gatekeepers: you connect your own wallet, you trade, and the assets never leave your control.
about.body3: We are a small team that prefers shipping honest software over marketing promises. The app tells you exactly what it does, what it charges, and what it cannot protect you from. We would rather you understand the risk than be pleasantly surprised by it later.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Fees are shown before you sign, every transaction is verifiable on-chain, and our contract is public.

innovation.title: New economy
innovation.body: We treat blockchain as real financial infrastructure, not a trend to chase.

access.title: Open access
access.body: No account, no approval, no minimum balance. A wallet is all you need.

security.title: Self-custody
security.body: We hold nothing. There is no company wallet for your funds to sit in and no withdrawal queue.

about.addressValue: أصفهان، خميني شهر، شارع الشهيد بهشتي، بجوار بلدية المنطقة ٤
about.custodyBody: This is a non-custodial exchange. Trades execute directly between your wallet and the blockchain. FBT iran has no access to your assets, cannot freeze or reverse a transaction, and cannot recover a lost seed phrase.
about.riskDisclosure: Trading crypto assets carries substantial risk, including total loss of capital. Prices are volatile and on-chain transactions are irreversible. Nothing in this app is financial advice. Only trade what you can afford to lose, and make sure you understand your local regulations.

contact.title: اتصل بنا
contact.intro: Questions, partnership enquiries or a bug to report — reach us directly.
contact.supportBody: We answer Instagram messages during Iranian business hours, usually within one working day. When reporting a problem with a trade, include the transaction hash — it lets us see exactly what happened on-chain.
contact.scamWarning: We will never DM you first, never ask for your seed phrase or wallet password, and never ask you to send crypto to an address for any reason. Anyone doing so while claiming to be FBT is impersonating us. Our only official contact is the Instagram account shown above.
